name: Firefighter telephone outlet plan symbol
summary: Plan symbol for a firefighter or emergency warden telephone outlet used for communication during an incident.
description: Firefighter telephone outlets, or warden intercommunication points, give two-way voice communication between floors and the fire control point. Plans draw a telephone handset mark or outlet tagged FFT, EWIS or WIP at stair landings and plant rooms.

The circuits are monitored and often fire-rated, so the plan symbol tells the installer to use the specified fire-resistant cable. Positions follow the fire code and brigade requirements. The symbol does not show whether the outlet is a jack for a portable handset or a fixed phone.
distinction: A general telephone outlet belongs to the communications network; this is a life-safety communication point.
